adapter_suite.scope: Existing RDKit Mol, OpenFF Molecule/Topology and ParmEd Structure test directories. No separate GromacsTopologyFile test directory exists in the selected source.

remaining_census.scope: Unchanged-source and byte-identical cached HTML only. Seventy-seven reviewed native/file/string and received provider articles have incremental receiving; this census is not a newly rebuilt full site or installed/scientific certificate.

semantic_review: RDKit declares 82 attributes. Its same-form registered route resolves to extract, not the old nonexistent to_rdkit_Mol documentation target. Atom/group stable inventory, ChemicalStates, conformer Structures and stored mechanical partial charges are distinguished.

OpenFF same-form molecule extraction uses the RDKit bridge; Topology subset/copy, single stored molecule and empty geometry limits are explicit. Provider floors and acquisition instructions survive without qualifying the literal minimum provider.

ParmEd element symbols, force-field labels, known versus unassigned charge defaults, coordinate/cell order and ordinary OpenMM Modeller capacity are distinct. No force field is assigned by these bridges.
Unavailable add/merge/append/copy hooks, empty setter modules and placeholder iterators are identified. A callable registered target alone does not certify every preservation profile.

OpenFF Topology exposes positions on the six-atom witness, while this adapter declares no coordinate capability and its native geometry routes return empty. The source is unchanged. #741 records optional post-1.0 geometry transport rather than adding a 1.0 gate.
failure_disposition: The first geometry probe compares provider-unit-converted coordinates with the original bare array bit for bit and wrongly fails its source-preservation assertion. The corrected probe compares actual before/after provider values and passes. The initial failed execution and observed values remain retained; no source mutation is inferred.

Ruff catches a generated nested double quote in an f-string that requires Python 3.12; formatting normalizes it to syntax compatible with the supported Python 3.11 floor before commit and test execution.

The selected existing adapter cohort passes 161 cases. Ten new source/declaration controls and all 278 combined source/actual-article controls pass, including the previous negative empty-converter case. No original failed run is relabelled.
limits: The retained source composition uses RDKit 2025.09.5, OpenFF Toolkit 0.19.0 and ParmEd 4.3.1. The provider imports/witness emit a retained Pint electric-potential redefinition log; pytest cohorts report no Python warnings. This is not a clean package/minimum-provider or platform matrix.

Five targeted cached-site HTML pages disable notebook execution and autosummary regeneration; all complete executable payloads, metadata, headings and anchors survive. The 77 reviewed articles are received incrementally, not freshly built as a complete site.

Nine flagged external-class pages / 178 role nodes remain among seventeen unchanged-source, byte-identical cached articles. #727 stays partial. #741 is optional post-1.0 work; no runtime adapter, scientific algorithm, public signature, native binary or storage format changes.

Original score, investigations, complete-source/nightly backlog, stable-format/client agreements and mandatory exact-source/scientific/installed final-pair gates remain separate; publication and candidate production stay paused.
